definitions.explanation: Japan's system of government payments to people who cannot support themselves, guaranteeing a minimum standard of living; also the payments themselves.

examples.japanese: {生活保護|せいかつほご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}けなく→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、{生活保護|せいかつほご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}した→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: He fell ill and could no longer work, so he applied for public assistance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧、{生活保護|せいかつほご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{半数|はんすう}→半数：30503_hansuu⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧になっている。
examples.english: With the population aging, over half of the households on public assistance are elderly households.

notes:
The right to it comes from Article 25 of the constitution, which guarantees a "minimum standard of wholesome and cultured living." Applications go through the local welfare office ({福祉事務所|ふくしじむしょ}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生活保護|せいかつほご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive public assistance
- {生活保護|せいかつほご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply for public assistance
- {生活保護|せいかつほご}{受給者|じゅきゅうしゃ}: welfare recipient

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{福祉|ふくし}→福祉：13748_fukushi⟧: welfare (in the broad sense)
- ⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧: pension
